Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul 2 nke Organic Skincare and Hair Products.

say: Nchekwa mbụ. Gbazee n'elu ite nke mmiri na-agba nwayọọ nwayọọ, nke a na-akpọ ọkụ ọkụ okpukpu abụọ. Debe okpomọkụ dị ala. Shea ekwesịghị ị smokingụ sịga ma ọ bụ sie ya, ị gaghị ahapụkwa ite ahụ.

panel.heading: Tupu ị gbazee ihe ọ bụla

cards.d: Jiri ọkụ ọkụ okpukpu abụọ na obere okpomọkụ. Shea ekwesịghị ise siga ma ọ bụ sie. Ahapụkwala ite ahụ.
Mmanụ gbazere nwere ike ime nnukwu ọkụ. Mee ka ụmụaka ghara ịnọ n'ebe ọrụ.

say: Usoro mmalite a pụrụ ịdabere na ya bụ ihe dịka 70% shea butter na 30% mmanụ mmiri. Maka otu gram 500, nke ahụ bụ 350 g nke shea.

Jupụta ite dị ọcha, kpọrọ nkụ na akara

say: Kpebie ihe mmanụ bụ maka tupu ịhọrọ mmanụ. A na-ahịhịa mmanụ akpụkpọ anụ n'ime oge ole na ole n'izu, ya mere ọ dị ọkụ ma dị ntakịrị na mmanụ dị mkpa. Mmanụ 100 g nke Chioma nwere mmanụ aki oyibo dị 50 g, olive 29 g, 20 g castor, na 1 g lavender.

panel.heading: Buru ụzọ kpebie ọrụ ahụ

say: Mmanụ a na-emechi maka ogologo na njedebe nwere ike ịba ụba karịa, yana castor ruru ihe dịka 40%.
Label ya na-ekwe nkwa nro, ọ bụghị uto.

Nwalee na ogwe aka dị n'ime maka ụbọchị 7 ruo 10, ma gbanwee naanị otu ihe n'etiti okirikiri.
